description: BD-PaveSurface is a public image collection of road surfaces on selected stretches of national highways N5 and N6 in Pabna District, Bangladesh. Smartphone field surveys covered rainy, winter and summer conditions and labelled clean original images as crack, pothole or good pavement. The Zenodo description counts 9,000 original images, with 3,000 per class, and 12,000 processed or augmented image files. It also names image metadata, scene-level train-validation-test splits, duplicate-audit results and a reproducibility notebook inside two large ZIP archives. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. Coverage is selected highway segments and three image categories, not a road-network inventory or measured deterioration trajectory. Scene similarity controls reduce leakage but do not establish transfer to different cameras, pavements or regions. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is supplying observed pavement-condition states to maintenance or inspection scenarios. data-lira-cd-road-condition-copenhagen is a related road-condition collection from another setting. The ZIP contents, split audit and annotation accuracy were not independently checked; no archive was downloaded.
